title: Timezone picker for admin
description: Allow admin users to select application timezone from /configuracion route
user_story: As an admin, I want to configure the clinic's timezone so appointments display correctly for different regions
acceptance_criteria: 1. Dropdown with common timezones (IANA database) 2. Saves to system_settings table in database 3. All date/time operations use selected timezone 4. Default to America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires
notes: Consider creating system_settings table. getAppTimezone() already exists and returns hardcoded value.

title: Server-side estado validation
description: Validate all consulta estado transitions on server before updating database
user_story: As a developer, I want estado changes validated server-side so malicious users cannot bypass UI restrictions
acceptance_criteria: 1. Create updateConsultaEstado server action 2. Use puedeTransicionarConRol for validation 3. Admin can bypass restrictions 4. Return clear Spanish error messages
notes: See backlog.md for implementation example code

title: Estado change UI components
description: UI components for displaying and changing consulta estados with role-based options
user_story: As a user, I want to see available estado transitions based on my role so I only see valid options
acceptance_criteria: 1. EstadoConsultaBadge component with colors 2. CambiarEstadoButton shows only permitted transitions 3. Tooltips with estado descriptions 4. Confirmation for critical transitions
notes: Use obtenerTransicionesPermitidas() and NOMBRES_ESTADOS from lib/types

title: Post-completada editing
description: Allow Médicos and Admins to edit medical details after completing a consulta
user_story: As a médico, I want to edit consultation notes after marking it complete in case I need to add information
acceptance_criteria: 1. Create updateConsultaDetalles server action 2. Validate only CAMPOS_EDITABLES_COMPLETADA are modified 3. Prevent editing CAMPOS_NO_EDITABLES_COMPLETADA 4. Show edit form only to authorized roles

title: Conflict detection update
description: Update scheduling conflict detection to use estados_consulta JOIN
user_story: As a user, I want the system to correctly detect scheduling conflicts excluding cancelled appointments
acceptance_criteria: 1. Update conflict query to JOIN estados_consulta 2. Use ESTADOS_NO_BLOQUEAN_AGENDA to exclude cancelled/ausente 3. Update bloqueaAgenda() function if needed

title: Estado change audit log
description: Track all consulta estado changes for auditing purposes
user_story: As an admin, I want to see the history of estado changes for compliance and debugging
acceptance_criteria: 1. Create consultas_estado_historial table 2. Log estado_anterior estado_nuevo usuario timestamp motivo 3. UI to view change history on consulta detail page

title: Multiple shifts per day
description: Allow doctors to have multiple non-overlapping shifts per day
user_story: As an admin, I want to configure morning and afternoon shifts separately for doctors
acceptance_criteria: 1. UI supports adding/removing multiple shifts per day 2. Validate no overlapping shifts 3. useFieldArray for dynamic form 4. Delete shift with confirmation
notes: Database already supports this - only UI changes needed. See medicos-horarios-improvements.md

title: Per-shift consultation duration
description: Allow different consultation durations for different shifts
user_story: As an admin, I want morning appointments to be 30min and afternoon appointments to be 45min
acceptance_criteria: 1. Add duracion_consulta column to medicos_horarios 2. Override medicos_parametros_agenda when set 3. UI to configure per-shift duration 4. Slot calculator uses shift-specific duration

title: Schedule exceptions
description: Allow one-time schedule overrides for specific dates (vacations holidays)
user_story: As an admin, I want to block a doctor's availability for a specific date without changing their regular schedule
acceptance_criteria: 1. Create medicos_horarios_excepciones table 2. Exception types: blocked unavailable modified 3. UI to add/view/remove exceptions 4. Slot calculator checks exceptions first

title: Consulta transfers audit
description: Track when consultas are transferred between médicos
user_story: As an admin, I want to see transfer history when appointments are reassigned
acceptance_criteria: 1. Create consultas_transferencias table 2. Log origen destino usuario motivo timestamp 3. UI to view transfer history 4. Trigger on medico_id change

title: Calendar view for consultas
description: Alternative calendar view (day/week/month) for viewing appointments
user_story: As a user, I want to see appointments in a calendar format for better schedule visualization
acceptance_criteria: 1. Toggle between grid and calendar views 2. Day week month views 3. Click appointment to navigate to detail 4. Color-coded by estado

title: Automated appointment reminders
description: Send SMS/email reminders to patients before appointments
user_story: As a clinic, I want patients reminded of appointments to reduce no-shows
acceptance_criteria: 1. Configure reminder timing (24h 1h before) 2. SMS and/or email options 3. Track delivery status 4. Patient opt-out option
notes: Out of scope for MVP - future phase. Requires SMS/email provider integration.

title: Patient self-service portal
description: Allow patients to view/cancel/reschedule their appointments online
user_story: As a patient, I want to manage my appointments without calling the clinic
acceptance_criteria: 1. Patient authentication (separate from staff) 2. View upcoming appointments 3. Cancel with reason 4. Request reschedule
notes: Out of scope for MVP - future phase. Major feature requiring separate auth flow.

title: Billing and invoicing
user_story: As an admin, I want to generate invoices for billing patients and insurance
acceptance_criteria: 1. Invoice generation from completed consulta 2. PDF export 3. Track payment status 4. Insurance claim support
notes: Out of scope for MVP - future phase. Requires accounting integration.

title: Advanced reporting
description: Analytics dashboard with appointment statistics and trends
user_story: As an admin, I want to see clinic performance metrics and identify trends
acceptance_criteria: 1. Appointments per day/week/month 2. No-show rates 3. Doctor utilization 4. Peak hours analysis
notes: Out of scope for MVP - future phase.

title: Customizable email templates
description: Allow admin to edit email templates for confirmation/reminder/cancellation notifications
user_story: As an admin, I want to customize the content of email notifications so they match the clinic's communication style
acceptance_criteria: 1. UI to edit templates for: confirmación recordatorio cancelación 2. Template variables support (paciente_nombre fecha_hora medico_nombre etc.) 3. Preview before saving 4. Revert to default option 5. Only accessible by Administrador role
notes: Templates already exist in /admin. Extend to allow full customization with variable placeholders.
